text: Does a steering signature help when both readers can represent steering? The repaired neutral-signature control gives zero gain in all nine settings. The strongest tested signature is nominated after three batches: its estimated content-loss reduction is 0.03127 nats, with a descriptive 95% interval of 0.02291–0.03962. The broader prediction fails: four of eight predicted strong settings remain below the 0.02-nat margin in point estimate. This is a constructed-method discovery, not confirmation or evidence about people.
